upcoming.title: Prostate artery embolization
upcoming.summary: Eases an enlarged prostate by reducing its blood supply.
upcoming.intro: As men get older the prostate often grows and presses on the tube that carries urine from the bladder, causing a weak stream, going often, or getting up at night. PAE reduces the prostate's blood supply through a catheter, so it softens and shrinks without surgery.

upcoming.title: Vertebroplasty and kyphoplasty
upcoming.summary: Stabilises a painful spinal fracture with bone cement, through a needle.
upcoming.intro: When a bone in the spine collapses, often because of thinning bone, it can cause severe back pain. Medical bone cement is injected through a needle into the broken bone, guided by imaging, to stabilise it. Many people find their pain eases within days.

upcoming.title: Endovascular aneurysm repair
upcoming.summary: Repairs a bulge in the body's main artery from the inside.
upcoming.intro: An aneurysm is a weak, ballooned section of the aorta. In EVAR, a fabric-covered tube called a stent graft is guided up from the groin and opened inside the aneurysm, so blood flows through the graft instead of pressing on the weak wall.

upcoming.title: Nephrostomy tube
upcoming.summary: Drains a kidney when the usual path out is blocked.
upcoming.intro: If the tube that carries urine from a kidney to the bladder is blocked, pressure builds up and can damage the kidney. A small tube is placed through the back into the kidney, guided by imaging, so urine can drain while the blockage is treated.

upcoming.title: PICC line
upcoming.summary: A soft IV line in the arm for treatment lasting weeks.
upcoming.intro: For long courses of antibiotics, chemotherapy or nutrition, a PICC line is a soft tube placed in an arm vein and threaded to a large vein near the heart, so treatment can be given for weeks without repeated needles.

upcoming.title: Chemoembolization of the liver
upcoming.summary: Delivers cancer treatment straight into a liver tumour's blood supply.
upcoming.intro: A catheter reaches the arteries feeding a liver tumour, delivers chemotherapy directly into them, then blocks them, so the treatment is concentrated where the tumour is.

upcoming.title: Biliary drain
upcoming.summary: Drains bile when the duct carrying it is blocked.
upcoming.intro: If a bile duct is blocked, bile backs up and can cause yellow skin, itching and infection. A thin tube is placed through the skin into the duct, guided by imaging, so bile can drain while the cause is treated.

upcoming.title: Varicose vein treatment
upcoming.summary: Closes a damaged leg vein from the inside.
upcoming.intro: Varicose veins form when small valves in a leg vein stop working and blood pools. The damaged vein is closed from the inside with heat or medical glue through a thin tube, and blood reroutes through healthy veins.
